name: Easy Turkey Stuffing "Skillet Dumpling" Soup with Broccoli, Cauliflower & Carrots

ingredients.name: vegetable medley (baby carrots, broccoli and cauliflower florets)

instructions.primary_message: Preheat a large ovenproof skillet over medium-high heat.
While the skillet heats up, peel, halve, and small dice onion.
Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add onion, turkey, and spices; cook, breaking the meat apart with a spoon, until browned and crumbly, 5-6 minutes. Remove from heat.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 tbsp extra virgin olive oil
1 lb ground turkey
½ tsp garlic powder
½ tsp salt
¼ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Meanwhile, place eggs and broth in a medium bowl, then whisk to combine. Add stuffing mix and whisk once more to combine.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 cup chicken or vegetable broth
1 (6 oz) pkg stuffing mix

instructions.primary_message: When the turkey is done, add stuffing mixture to the skillet and stir to combine. Gently pat down with the back of a spoon, then cover tightly with aluminum foil. Place stuffing in the preheated oven, and bake until cooked through, about 50 minutes. Remove foil and continue to bake until golden and firm, 30 minutes more. Remove from oven and set aside to cool slightly.

When the stuffing is done, place additional broth and veggies in a large pot. Bring to a boil over high heat, then reduce heat to medium and cook until veggies are tender, 3-4 minutes. Remove from heat.
instructions.secondary_message:
chicken or vegetable broth
1 ½ (12 oz) bag vegetable medley (baby carrots, broccoli and cauliflower florets)

instructions.primary_message: To serve, divide broth, veggies, and stuffing cubes between bowls. Enjoy!
